metaDescription: Order custom medium shirts in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for corporate teams and events. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Medium is the most versatile size for branded shirts, fitting a wide range of body types and making it a smart choice for corporate uniforms, event staff, or promotional giveaways. Whether you need button-downs for a professional look or henleys for a casual team outing, medium sizes ensure a consistent, flattering fit across your group. Add your logo with embroidery or screen printing for a polished finish.
